color.note: Values are the live cockpit.css layer (it overrides style.css in the task-based shell). Light is the primary theme; dark follows the app's prefers-color-scheme block; safe is an ADDED light theme (data-theme="safe") whose status colours are told apart by hue family and lightness, built on Okabe & Ito's set: ok leaves the red–green axis toward blue, bad is vermillion, warn ochre, info a plain grey. Every other token inherits light. Contrast figures in the notes are WCAG 2 ratios, light / dark (safe where it differs).

tokens.name: brand-forest
tokens.usage: The identity green at its darkest: the cover's big block, print and marketing. In the UI it is the sidebar ground (see side). Constant in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-emerald
tokens.usage: The identity green at full value, for logos, marketing and charts. In the UI use accent for graphics and accent-strong for text and fills.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind cards; also the hover fill of secondary buttons and the track of a segmented control. Text on it: ink, muted.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, the top bar, inputs, the Hank drawer, the selected segment of a quiet segmented control. Text on it: ink, muted.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground and the camera placeholder. Text on it: side-ink, side-ink-strong, side-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on bg and card (14:1 / 15:1). Also the ink of nav icons in the asset files.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and card: 4.9:1 on bg and 5.2:1 on card light, 8.3:1 / 7.4:1 dark. Never below 13px on bg.

tokens.name: muted-on-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on accent-soft and the other soft fills, where muted falls to 4.6:1.

tokens.name: side-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar links and icons at rest on side (10.9:1 / 13:1).

tokens.name: side-ink-strong
tokens.usage: Brand name, the hovered and the active sidebar link on side.

tokens.name: side-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar captions (WORKSPACE, RESOURCES) and the footer on side (7.2:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards and tiles, dividers between rows, the top-bar rule. Decorative: never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons, chips and the segmented control. 1.6:1 on card: the control's fill and text carry the contrast, not this border.

tokens.name: side-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on side: the logo's inset ring, the dark theme and language switches.

tokens.name: side-fill
tokens.usage: Pill fill on side (the online pill in the phone top bar).

tokens.name: side-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a sidebar link.

tokens.name: side-active
tokens.usage: Fill of the active sidebar link, with the nav-active bar.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Graphics only: chart bands, gauge marks, timeline dots, the leaf pattern on the cover, the light-history bar. Not for text, and no white text on it (4.5:1 light). In the safe theme: Okabe–Ito blue.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Green text and links on bg (5.5:1 / 10.3:1) and card (5.9:1 / 9.2:1), the primary button fill with on-accent, the focus ring on bg and card, the active page tab. In the safe theme a dark blue (6.4:1 on bg, 6.8:1 on card, 6.1:1 on accent-soft): ok leaves the red–green axis entirely.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-strong (5.9:1 / 9.7:1) and on the selected segment.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for the ok status chip, the soft button (Check lamp distance), explanation panels, the current week in the feed chart. Text on it: accent-strong (5.2:1), muted-on-soft. In the safe theme a blue tint.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and the ink of warn chips and banners on warn-soft (6.1:1 / 8.9:1) and on card (6.7:1). The needs-you and setup-needed states. In the safe theme an ochre (5.7:1 on warn-soft, 6.3:1 on card): yellow family, told from bad by hue and by the icon and word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning fill: status chips, banners, the action-center symbol, the setup-needed callout. In the safe theme a yellow tint.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Error text and the ink of bad chips and banners on bad-soft (5.6:1 / 7.8:1) and on card (6.2:1). The stopped, offline and failed states; the notification badge fill. In the safe theme a dark vermillion (6.5:1 on bad-soft, 7.3:1 on card): Okabe–Ito vermillion darkened for text.

tokens.name: bad-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive or armed button (Switch the rule off, Stop pump now, the Off mode while the autopilot runs) with on-bad-fill text (5.4:1). Same in both themes. In the safe theme a darkened vermillion (5.1:1 with on-bad-fill).

tokens.name: on-bad-fill
tokens.usage: Text on bad-fill.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Error fill: banners, the alarm tile, the urgent strip on phones. In the safe theme a vermillion tint.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and the ink of info chips on info-soft (6:1 / 9:1). The paused, waiting and suggestion states. In the safe theme a plain grey-green (6.2:1 on info-soft): information carries no signal hue.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Informational fill: chips, the watering weeks in the feed plan. In the safe theme a neutral tint.

tokens.name: sel-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an exclusive choice: the chosen choice chip, the active legend pill. Text: sel-ink.

tokens.name: sel-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sel-bg (17:1).

tokens.name: num-bg
tokens.usage: Counter badge fill (Hank's unread count). Text: num-ink.

tokens.name: num-ink
tokens.usage: Text on num-bg.

tokens.name: dot-ok
tokens.usage: The online dot on the sidebar and phone top bar. Same hue as the logo's leaves. In the safe theme sky blue (6.5:1 on side).

tokens.name: dot-bad
tokens.usage: The offline dot on the sidebar and phone top bar. In the safe theme vermillion (3.9:1 on side).

tokens.name: dot-demo
tokens.usage: The demo-data dot on the sidebar and phone top bar.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: The 3px inset bar on the active sidebar link, and the focus ring on side (8.2:1). In the safe theme sky blue.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Translucent dark behind the REC badge on video and behind the sidebar drawer on phones. Text on it: side-ink-strong.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page title (h1) in the top bar. One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: The title of a page's hero card (Autopilot, the box overview) and headings that sit between cards. Nothing inside a card is larger than the card's own title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles (h3) and the Hank drawer title.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Hank needs your help with these devices
styles.usage: Labels, button text, device names in a card header, sub-headings inside a card, the disclosure summary.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Humidity did not rise after switching on; check the humidifier.
styles.usage: All running text: reasons, descriptions, timeline entries, banners, form help. The floor for a paragraph; max measure 68ch.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: Field labels, status-chip text, the small button, the footer's online state.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: paused until 9:37 AM, you took over
styles.usage: The line under a name, hints under a field, footer notes, the top bar's box name. The smallest size a sentence is set in.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Readings 51 s ago · Device status 8 min ago
styles.usage: Metadata that is never a sentence: timestamps, the readings age, axis labels, tile keys, the counter badge. Never below 12px anywhere.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Captions over a group: WORKSPACE and RESOURCES in the sidebar, STEPS AND REASONS over the timeline, tile keys.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Tile values and KPIs. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; the unit beside it in small, muted.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: A device reading in a card header or a row, right-aligned, tabular-nums.

spacing.note: A 4px base. 20px is the card step the live app already uses everywhere from 700px up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a status dot and its word; the segmented control's inner padding; chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips or buttons in a row; label-to-field gap; timeline row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar link padding; banner padding; row padding inside cards; icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and grid gap below 700px; button horizontal padding; top-bar vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and grid gap from 700px up; the distance between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page top padding; the brand block's bottom padding; space between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above the sidebar footer; the indent of a disclosure's body.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Cover insets; the sidebar's top padding region; space kept clear above the Hank button.

radius.note: Three steps plus the pill. Nested corners stay concentric: inner radius = outer radius minus the padding (segment 6 inside a 10 track with 4 padding).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, choice chips, small buttons, a segment inside a segmented control, image thumbnails, the brand mark at sidebar size.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, sidebar links, banners, the segmented control track, icon buttons, the camera zoom control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, panels, the Hank drawer's top corners, the cover's blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and status chips, the box selector, counter badges, legend pills.

shadow.note: Borders do the work; shadows are near-invisible by design.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The Hank button and the Hank drawer: the only floating surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-segment

tokens.name: control-h-touch

tokens.name: control-h-sm

tokens.name: icon

tokens.name: icon-sm

tokens.name: topbar-h

tokens.name: opacity-disabled

tokens.name: opacity-paused
